decisive_items: CT-guided biopsy of a pulmonary nodule demonstrated a malignant neoplasm composed of spindle cells
Immunohistochemical staining of the tumor cells was positive for CD99
Immunohistochemical staining of the tumor cells was positive for TLE-1
response.rationale: Only candidate provided; however, TLE-1 positivity and spindle cell morphology are more typical of synovial sarcoma than Ewing's sarcoma, so support is weak.
